messages:
incidents-bot: Pager: High 502/504 rate detected on api-gateway-east-1. svc=api-gateway env=prod threshold=5% over 3m. Paging alice (oncall). :rotating_light:

alice (oncall): seeing it in datadog too. spike started ~7765432050. 502s from cloudfront -> edge-proxy.

ben (sre): looking at edge logs now. preliminary: upstream timeouts 504 and some 502s with 'upstream reset'. Could be origin saturation or connection pool exhaustion.

carol (edge): confirming — a subset of edge nodes showing 20-30% 5xx. inbound requests are normal, error responses from internal mux->gateway.

alice (oncall): rolling mitigation: 1) enable 5xx circuit-break on edge for problematic routes 2) scale gateway pool by +20% 3) route traffic away from bad nodes. Ben/Carol can you run those?

ben (sre): running scale up now. aws autoscaling: set desired_capacity=48 -> 58 for gw-asg-east.

carol (edge): enabling circuit-break: route /v1/complete set cb-options {consecutive-errors:50, interval:60s, cooldown:120s} (temporary). Applying to edge config now.

incidents-bot: Deploy job started: deploy-edge-config/2026-03-15T01:03Z by carol. CI check passed.

ben (sre): ASG update pushed, instances launching. healthchecks showing some new nodes initializing.

dmitri (infra): I'm seeing a small spike of TCP RSTs between edge and gateway in eu-west-1. Might be connection limit hitting per-host. Increasing netty connection pool limit on gateway instances (hot config)

alice (oncall): good. can we also enable short-term 429-based backpressure from edge to limit request fanout? that reduces retries causing congestion.

carol (edge): enabled slow-path 429 threshold for noisy clients for 5m window. Added rate-limit for header X-App-Retry.

eva (support): any known customer impact yet? support dashboard shows uptick in error rates for a few enterprise tenants (org-42, org-77). I opened an interim incident page for those customers.

alice (oncall): estimate: ~10% of requests for those tenants failing with 502/504 during the spike window. Flag as P2 with customer-notify potential.

ben (sre): logs after mitigations: overall 5xx dropped from 18% -> 4% in 3 min. New gateway nodes healthy. Some older gateway hosts still report elevated 502s — planning to gracefully drain and reboot them.

carol (edge): draining nodes id: gw-34, gw-39. Traffic diversion in progress.

incidents-bot: Alert suppressed: rate normalized below threshold for metric svc=api-gateway env=prod.

dmitri (infra): noted root cause hypothesis: connection pool exhaustion due to recent change in client retry behavior + a config regression in upstream keepalive settings (reduced from 90s -> 10s) in last rollout. Filing a rollback candidate.

alice (oncall): thanks. can we capture a repro window? ben, export logs (5m window 7765432045-7765432105) and trace ids for failing requests. Include sampling of 502 stack traces.

ben (sre): exporting now. gist: https://internal.gds/gists/abcd1234 (contains sanitized logs + trace ids).

eva (support): prepping customer comms: short note: "We're investigating elevated 502/504 errors impacting a subset of requests; mitigations in progress. We'll follow up within 30 minutes." Anyone object?

alice (oncall): go ahead and send. include workaround: retry after 10s and exponential backoff; say we're throttling noisy clients.

carol (edge): full mitigation plan: 1) revert keepalive regression in next canary 2) add connection pool telemetry alarm 3) update runbook to include backpressure knob. I'll open GH PR for the rollback.

dmitri (infra): PR #5567 opened to revert keepalive change. tagging for expedited review.

ben (sre): draining complete for old nodes. 502 rate stable ~3%. Can start handoff in 20 min if everyone OK.

alice (oncall): agree. start 0600UTC handoff to morning oncall (dmitri). I'll leave runbook notes in incident doc and add follow-ups: postmortem, customer impact table, test to prevent keepalive regression.

incidents-bot: Incident update posted: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-0315-502spike (short summary + actions).

eva (support): sent customer note to org-42/77. will wait for postmortem before broader comms.

carol (edge): post-incident telemetry: adding guardrails — will enable canary limit on keepalive parameter.

alice (oncall): handoff: dmitri takes ownership at 0600UTC. current status: mitigated, scaling/drain done, rollback PR pending, exports uploaded. open action items: (1) postmortem owner ben (2) rollback QA carol (3) customer follow-up eva.

dmitri (infra): acknowledged. I'll pick this up for morning and coordinate the rollback. thanks team.

ben (sre): quick note for postmortem: time-to-detect ~2m, mitigation ~8m, customer-impact window ~6m, root cause candidate: keepalive regression + retry storm.

alice (oncall): closing incident channel here. leave any async updates on the incident page. great job everyone :thumbsup:
